solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, number freed: 1 down to 2); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Part that is holding others up on stage

definitions.text: Part that is holding others up on stage

parts.words: Part that is holding others up on stage
parts.note: read literally, a theatrical part that props up the other actors, i.e. a secondary role backing the leads

explanation.surface: Something in a theatre is propping up the cast on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Holding others up' sounds like physical support of people or scenery, but it means a minor role that backs up the stars.
explanation.definitionFit: A secondary theatrical part that backs up the principal performers is the standard term in acting.

clue.text: Continue look into projecting part that's pointed

indicators.note: into means the short word is placed inside the longer one

parts.note: a prong is a pointed projecting tine
lo is an old word for look

explanation.surface: Keep peering at a sharp spike.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong something is to extend it, making it continue longer.

clue.text: Egg senior cleric placed on cooker

parts.note: an egg is O-shaped
Ven. is short for Venerable, the title of an archdeacon

explanation.surface: An archdeacon sets an egg on the stove.
explanation.walkthrough: 'placed on' is a link: in a down answer the egg sits above the cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: An oven is the part of a cooker used for baking and roasting.

clue.text: Lorry driver found a helpless maid in winding street

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the rearranged street
winding suggests the street twists into another order
help-less means the word for help, aid, is removed

explanation.surface: A trucker comes across a defenceless girl in a twisting road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winding' rearranges the street; 'helpless' means help-less, so the synonym of help is taken out of the maid, leaving one letter to go in with A. Teamster is the North American term.
explanation.definitionFit: A teamster is a truck driver, the American term originally for a driver of a team of horses.

clue.text: See something on board

definitions.meaning: a sign pinned up on a ... board

explanation.surface: Look at what is pinned to the board.
explanation.definitionFit: Notice is both a verb meaning observe and a noun for a posted announcement.

clue.text: Attendant in set runs for electronic receiver

parts.note: a radio is a set, as in a wireless set
a page is a young attendant
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A servant on a film set rushes off to fetch a device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'for' are links; the pieces sit in sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio pager is a small electronic device that receives messages, a bleeper.

clue.text: A medical man in most recent thrash

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the other word

parts.note: last means latest, most recent
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A doctor was in the latest beating.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambast is to thrash or beat, or figuratively criticise harshly.

clue.text: Gold box to 22 and score

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a chest is a large box
the answer to 22 is assess, which means to rate

explanation.surface: Gold is packed with a judgement and a tally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; 22 points to another clue whose answer is a synonym for rate.
explanation.definitionFit: To score music is to arrange it for instruments, just as to orchestrate does.

clue.text: Prediction favouring Oriental players

parts.note: being for something is favouring it
E stands for East, the Orient
a cast is the set of players in a show

explanation.surface: A forecast that backs a team of Eastern players.
explanation.definitionFit: A forecast is a prediction of what will happen, as with the weather.

clue.text: Raise objections when not completely reserved

indicators.note: not completely means the synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: demure means modest and reserved

explanation.surface: Someone complains when they are only partly shy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not completely' drops the last E of DEMURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise objections or show reluctance, a verb sense.

clue.text: Chance for second-rate talent

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
B is the grade below A, second-rate
ability is talent or skill

explanation.surface: An opportunity arises for a mediocre talent.
explanation.definitionFit: Probability is the likelihood or chance of something happening.

clue.text: Some unpatriotic disturbance

indicators.note: some of the word means just part of its letters are taken, a run in the middle

explanation.surface: A bit of disloyal unrest breaks out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals the run inside unpatRIOTic.
explanation.definitionFit: A riot is a violent public disturbance by a crowd.

clue.text: Film direction taken by mental case

parts.note: Psycho is the 1960 Hitchcock film
a path is a way or direction to follow

explanation.surface: A movie's director was hired by a madman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken by' is a link: the film and the direction are simply placed side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A psychopath is someone with a severe personality disorder, informally a mental case.

clue.text: Chanticleer, leaving Cuba, moving out of difficulty

indicators.note: moving suggests the remaining letters shift about
leaving means one letter departs from the name

parts.note: C is the international vehicle code for Cuba

explanation.surface: A rooster quits Cuba and escapes trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' drops a C from CHANTICLEER and 'moving' rearranges HANTICLEER. Chanticleer is the rooster of medieval fable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the clear means being free of suspicion or danger, out of trouble.

clue.text: First-class student

parts.note: read not as a top scholar but as a pupil who is in the first class, a newcomer starting out

explanation.surface: A student who earns top honours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First-class' suggests excellence; here it means in the very first class, a starter.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner in their first lesson is a novice, someone only starting out.

clue.text: Spiny plant cut sack almost completely

annotationWithheld.why: Spiny plant cut sack almost completely (6): only parse is an anagram of CUT + SAC(k), so 'cut' is both fodder and the only possible anagram indicator
annotationWithheld.clue: Spiny plant cut sack almost completely

clue.text: Negotiating a fort, Don moving both ways

indicators.note: negotiating a route means weaving round obstacles, so the letters are steered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone named Don manoeuvres around a fortress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Negotiating' suggests bargaining, but it signals that A FORT DON is rearranged; 'moving' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to and fro means moving back and forth, in both directions.

clue.text: Be affected by continuous pain when it is pebbly

parts.note: achy means aching, suffering a dull lasting pain

explanation.surface: Someone suffers a nagging ache when walking on stones.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when it is' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A beachy shore is covered in shingle, so pebbly is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Do not start to pine despite great pain

indicators.note: do not start means the first letter is removed

parts.note: to languish is to pine away

explanation.surface: An instruction not to mope in spite of suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do not start' drops the L; 'despite' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Anguish is severe mental or physical suffering, great pain.

clue.text: Three got drunk simultaneously

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: Three people got drunk at the same time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges THREE GOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing things together means doing them at the same time.

clue.text: There was no holding him!

parts.note: read literally, a man no chains, locks or tanks could hold: the great escapologist

explanation.surface: An exclamation about someone unstoppable.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom means he was unstoppable; literally, no restraint could keep him.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Hungarian-American escape artist freed himself from every restraint.

clue.text: Work out value of she-donkey?

parts.note: an ass is a donkey
-ess is the suffix that makes a noun female, as in lioness

explanation.surface: A question about the worth of a female donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: The suffix is placed after the animal, so a female donkey becomes, humorously, the donkey plus a feminine ending.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess is to evaluate, working out the value of something.

clue.text: Reason I make notes whilst arguing

parts.note: logic is reasoning
to sing is to produce musical notes

explanation.surface: A thinker makes notes while debating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whilst' is a link; 'make notes' means musical notes, not writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Logicising is reasoning in a formal way, as when arguing a case.

clue.text: Little pig's noise did not start

indicators.note: did not start means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a grunt is the noise a pig makes

explanation.surface: A piglet's squeal failed to begin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'did not start' drops the G of GRUNT; the 's links the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The runt is the smallest, weakest piglet of a litter.

clue.text: Turned up with mother wildcat

indicators.note: turned means the short word is read backwards

parts.note: ma is mother

explanation.surface: A big cat appeared with its mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned' reverses UP to PU; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The puma, or cougar, is a large wild cat of the Americas.

clue.text: It became yours

parts.note: an old second-person possessive that turned into the modern 'yours' as English changed

explanation.surface: Something now belongs to you.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a gift; it is a word history: the archaic possessive was replaced by modern 'yours'.
explanation.definitionFit: The archaic singular possessive of thou was superseded in ordinary speech by 'yours'.

clue.text: A flue five suffered having noxious vapours

indicators.note: suffered suggests the letters are made to go through hardship and rearranged

parts.note: the printed words, read as the setter meant them, A FLU FIVE, supply the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Five people caught flu, giving off bad smells.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffered' rearranges A FLU FIVE; the printed 'flue' has one E too many, the setter's slip. 'having' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Effluvia are unpleasant or harmful smells and gases given off by something.

clue.text: It's impossible to guess why everybody is quiet

definitions.meaning: a phrase meaning nobody can predict the outcome
taken literally, the reason for silence: no one is uttering anything

explanation.surface: Nobody can predict why the room has gone silent.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means the outcome cannot be predicted, and literally says no speaking is taking place.
